title: Self-contradicting oath copy: header and option state opposite rules
body:
The Wolf-Winter oath prompt contradicts itself inside a single message.

Header:                "Every approach stays open."
Its only option's tradeoff: "Other promise/report pairs close."

Both render on one screen, in one response, from `albany:wolf_relief_oath`. One of the
two is wrong and a player has no way to tell which — and the subject is which
irreversible commitments they are about to make, so guessing is expensive.

Reproduced independently in two sessions by two different players:
  - a live-test QA lead, on the Road Warden background
  - a reference-tier session (claude-opus-5), also on Road Warden, decision 3

Same lineage both times (claude), so this is corroboration of the observation rather than
cross-vendor confirmation — but both readings agree exactly on the wording.

Related shape worth checking while in there: the same oath choice renders three
selectable options on one background and, on Road Warden, exactly one option plus a
read-only `revealOption`. If "every approach stays open" is true only on the branches
with three options, then the header is branch-dependent text being shown unconditionally,
which would explain the contradiction and point straight at the fix.

evidence.summary: Reproduced in two independent sessions on the Road Warden branch.
